title: Hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-K Routing: Two-Sided Dependence Control for Frozen Mixture-of-Experts at Fixed Per-Token Routing Laws
abstract: arXiv:2607.28670v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A stochastic Gumbel-Top-K router defines, for every token of a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, a routing law: a distribution over ordered expert lists and mixture weights. We ask which joint distributions over the routing choices of different tokens are reachable while every individual token's complete routing law is held exactly fixed. We give a two-sided construction, Hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-K (CGA). Within a group of related tokens, an exchangeable Gaussian copula positively correlates the Gumbel perturbations at each expert coordinate, which can increase within-group expert-set coherence. Across disjoint pairs of groups, a tunable antithetic construction introduces a selectable amount of negative dependence. We prove that both operations leave each token's ordered Top-K sample, mixture weights, and inclusion probabilities identical in distribution to independent routing at a routing layer conditioned on its pre-routing log

translated_title: 分层Copula-Gumbel-Top-K路由：固定每令牌路由法则下的冻结混合专家模型双侧依赖控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.28670v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：随机Gumbel-Top-K路由器为混合专家（MoE）模型的每个令牌定义了一个路由法则：即关于有序专家列表和混合权重的分布。我们探讨了在保持每个单独令牌的完整路由法则完全固定的前提下，不同令牌路由选择之间的哪些联合分布是可实现的。我们提出了一种双侧构造方法，即分层Copula-Gumbel-Top-K（CGA）。在相关令牌组内，可交换高斯Copula正相关地关联每个专家坐标上的Gumbel扰动，这可以增强组内专家集的一致性。在不相交的组对之间，可调的对偶构造引入了可选择的负依赖程度。我们证明了这两种操作都使得每个令牌的有序Top-K样本、混合权重和包含概率在分布上等同于在其路由前log条件下独立路由的结果。
tldr: 本文提出一种分层Copula-Gumbel-Top-K构造，能够在保持每个令牌路由法则完全不变的同时，灵活控制不同令牌间路由选择的联合分布（组内正相关、组间负相关），实现了对冻结混合专家模型路由依赖的双侧调控。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-K construction that flexibly controls the joint distribution of routing choices across tokens (positive within groups, negative between groups) while keeping each token's routing law exactly fixed, enabling two-sided dependence control for frozen mixture-of-experts models.
